resources.string: Keep your existing sort order and search limits.
Quality tiers and trusted release groups, with a preference for movies under 30 GB and episodes under 5 GB. Larger releases remain available.
Prioritize remuxes, high-quality encodes and trusted release groups. 1080p remuxes rank above 4K WEB-DL. No preferred size ceiling.
Prefer 1080p WEB releases and efficient codecs, with movies under 12 GB and episodes under 2 GB. Keep larger alternatives below.
Your quality tiers, priorities and conditional scoring rules. Edit and preview them from your phone.
Choose a preset or customize quality tiers, languages and release-group rules. Preview the order before saving.
The sorting profile is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
Start with a preset. Open Customize when you want more control. Save applies the profile to this TV profile; Preview does not save.
Comma-separated codes, in order: en, ja, nl, de, fr, es, it, pt, ko, zh, hi, ru, uk, ar, pl, tr, multi, dual. Language tags are inferred from release names; missing tags remain eligible.
A preference, not a filter. Larger releases stay below. 0 means no preference. Season packs use per-episode size when known; unknown sizes remain eligible.
Keep this many results per resolution/quality category near the top. Extra releases follow and remain available. 0 keeps the strict sorted order.
Applied from top to bottom. Move Rule score above Quality tier to let strong scoring rules outweigh a quality tier. Known failed releases always remain below eligible releases.
First matching tier wins. Empty resolutions or qualities match any value. Unmatched and unknown releases remain eligible below named tiers.

All matching score rules add their points. Require and Exclude are filters; set a minimum remaining count to apply a filter only when enough alternatives remain. Rules use release names and indexer metadata, not media probes.
One release per line: release name | size in GB | age in days | indexer. Size, age and indexer are optional. This previews the profile only; the search limits on your TV still apply to real results.
Share native Nuvio profiles without provider passwords or indexer keys. Import loads a draft; review and Save to apply it.
Profile imported as a draft. Preview or Save to apply it.
0 applies the filter strictly. A higher value keeps existing candidates when filtering would leave fewer eligible results. Known failed releases do not count as alternatives.

Use comma-separated values for Is / Is not. Quality: REMUX, BLURAY, WEB_DL, WEBRIP, HDTV, DVD, CAM, UNKNOWN. Codec: HEVC, AVC, AV1, UNKNOWN. Visual: HDR, DV, HDR_DV, DV_ONLY, HDR10_PLUS, SDR. Regex supports case-insensitive regular expressions without lookaround or backreferences.
